s.how: Toss 1kg chicken wings with salt and bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Warm 125ml barbecue sauce with 2 tbsp honey and toss the wings through. Mix sour cream with mayonnaise and chives for a ranch dip and serve alongside.

Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. Halve and mash the yolks with mayonnaise and Dijon until smooth, then pipe back into the whites. Press a round slice of black olive into the centre of each like a single big eye and dust with paprika.

m.how: Roll 600g beef mince into meatballs and brown. Add 2 cans crushed tomatoes and simmer 40 minutes. Split a baguette, spread with garlic butter and bake until crisp. Toss the sauce through 500g spaghetti with parmesan and serve the lot.

w.note: Sulley's blue fur with purple spots
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, then 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 175C for 18 minutes and cool. Beat butter, icing sugar and blue colouring and pipe with a grass tip for shaggy fur. Add purple sprinkles.

d.how: Fill glasses or small clean cans with ice. Add a splash of lime cordial and top up with cold lemonade. Stir once and serve. Screams not required, but the scarers will tell you otherwise.
